ui.dialog:
OPERATOR HANDBOOK
×
MOVE WITH PURPOSE.

TOUCH: Left stick moves proportionally. Drag the right side to look. Hold FIRE and drag the same thumb to aim while moving. AIM and RUN toggle. DASH phases forward; JUMP vaults low cover. Hold USE while entering a receiver ring or suit service. MAP pauses and selects a route.

The Custodian arms after the third memory. Match the physical I / II / III plates to the coil cells. A small numbered bracket marks one clear component: amber is armored, cyan is exposed. It marks a visible surface, not a safe position. Dark coils are inert cover; move to a clear face for the remaining targets. Destroy its three copper coils: armored shutters take chip damage; after each volley they lift for critical hits. Use that exposed-coil window to return fire: patrols keep moving, and incoming shots and close discharges remain dangerous. Amber lanes lock before firing: move behind cover. DASH close to a charging coil cancels the volley and opens shutters for 3 seconds.

Tap SWAP to switch between precision rifle and pump breacher. The breacher fires eight physical pellets: strongest within 6 m, fading to zero at 24 m. ADS narrows spread modestly. RELOAD inserts one shell every 0.55 seconds; fire interrupts after a shell seats. Switching cancels an unfinished insertion. Fallen supplies add 4 shells; memories add 8, capped at 36 reserve. Memory recovery partially restores health and shield.

CROUCH toggles a lower physical posture and slower movement. Stand only with clear headroom; Tap CROUCH again to request standing. Stance changes are accepted only while grounded and outside phase/vault. Crouched jumps retain the low body; stand before vaulting. Low cover blocks only suitable angles, so watch high ground and flanks.

Tap JUMP near thin waist-high cover to vault when the landing is clear; otherwise jump. Vaulting commits briefly: firing and phase wait until landing. Tall walls still require a route around. Tap MAP to pause and select an objective. Watch patrols: the trace knows architecture, not danger.

One-use EMERGENCY SUIT SERVICE is behind the west extraction blast plate. It powers after three memories and the defeated Custodian. hold USE for 2 uninterrupted seconds on the floor: +40 health (cap 100) and armor refilled to 60. Applied damage interrupts; flanks remain exposed. Extraction uploads only while grounded inside the marked uplink deck. Outside pauses briefly; reenter before decay.

Engineering has two single-use amber capacitor banks. Shoot the cabinet or isolator: a 1.1-second warning precedes a 6 m discharge. Move clear, use solid cover or phase protection. The spent cabinet remains cover. Enemy fire cannot trigger it.

Patrol perimeter shutters lift amber for 0.55 seconds before a radial proximity discharge. Back beyond reach, break solid-cover sight, jump to unreachable height, or DASH to interrupt. A miss still cools for one second; existing projectiles remain dangerous.

Soul Shift protects briefly. Dash within 4.5 m of a charging enemy to cancel its shot or proximity discharge and stagger it for 0.8 s. A blue emitter flash confirms the break. Dashing toward a charge stops early on a successful break so you can follow up. Sideways dodges retain full travel. It deals no damage; the 4.5 s cooldown still applies. Your shield regenerates when you avoid damage.

THREAT VISOR · Orange ! means a charging threat. Muted chevrons show recent fire or hits. A number counts nearby sources in that direction; one source has no number. Offscreen cues use broad direction sectors, not exact positions. Optic brackets stay beside visible emitters. The lower readout follows one target near aim. Cues require clear optic sight and expire.

UNDERSTOOD
↗
